name: Torngat Mountains
description: The highest mountains in Canada east of the Rockies, at the northern tip of Labrador on the Quebec boundary: peaks over 1,500 m, Mount Caubvick / Mont D'Iberville at 1,652 m, fjords cutting deep into the ranges, over 40 small cirque glaciers (the only glaciers left in eastern continental North America) and almost no forest. Reached by sea or air only.

attributes.physiographic_level: Davis Region of the Canadian Shield

notable_heights.name: Mount Caubvick / Mont D'Iberville (NL–QC boundary; highest point of both)
